national.title: 6 Ribu Sekolah di Italia Dapat Teror Bom, Bikin Panik hingga Siswa Dievakuasi
national.summary: Sekolah-sekolah di Italia dievakuasi akibat ancaman bom palsu. PM Meloni menyatakan tidak ada bahaya nyata dan penyelidikan sedang dilakukan.

international.title: Trump praises Hegseth after failed impeachment effort and shrugs off Iran war criticism - live
international.summary: President claims US ‘did not start war with Iran’ in Veterans Day speech where he also backed defense secretary again day after failed impeachment vote Democrats lambast absent peers over failed Hegseth impeachment House Republicans block effort to impeach Hegseth Sign up for the US Breaking News email Some Democrats, out of the 11 who missed the key procedural vote on Tuesday to impeach Pete Hegseth, blamed a traffic jam in Washington DC for their inability to make it to the US Capitol in time . By a vote of 211-204, Republicans referred the articles of impeachment to the judiciary committee – effectively killing the effort to oust Hegseth. Continue reading...

international.title: More than one million people in Lebanon face acute food shortages, UN says
international.summary: UN warns hunger crisis affecting almost quarter of Lebanon's population could escalate without 'urgent action'.

international.title: Schools in Italy, Scotland and Northern Ireland hit by threats in suspected bomb hoax
international.summary: More than 6,000 Italian schools received a threat. Authorities in all three countries say there appears to be no risk to the public. It is not known if the incidents are linked.
